text: I don't usually write reviews, but I feel as if I should share my frustration. I bought Diablo 4 on my PS5 and also on Steam, both are the same account, same characters, same progression. I purchased the ultimate edition on PS5 because that is what I was playing on most of the time. When I decided to switch back over to my PC I came to the realization that none of my DLC I bought on PS5 works on my PC. They want me to purchase the DLC across all platforms? I purchased the most expensive bundle, so I'm assuming if I buy the base DLC I wont be able to use any of my premium cosmetics? Not cool.

Just not my favorite play style. With all combat based on attack combinations, you find yourself walking through the same combinations over and over again, against every mob, rather than using individual skills against different types of opponents or as required by different situations. I guess if what you want to do is program a couple of key macros to auto execute the attack combinations, then you'll be able to pretty much sleep your way through this game. I wish them luck. Just not sure that I'll be along for the ride.
